# Code Red
## Called by:
Any two Command members, Head of Security, or Captain/ACO.
## Conditions:
There is a confirmed, hostile threat on-board the station or nearby in space. This threat should pose an active and recognisable danger to the station and/or crew at large.
## Security:
1. Officers may be provided with any Security department equipment without permit. Officers may carry any form of ammunition or armament available to them from the Security Techfab.
2. Officers may brandish any weaponry at any time, and may freely use both non-lethal and lethal grenades permitted for departmental use. Officer discretion is still highly recommended.
3. Officers may not utilise any contraband equipment without a permit, and are not to use any form of highly illegal contraband whatsoever without a Central Command-issued permit.
4. Random searches are fully permitted and recommended. Security personnel may detain any personnel refusing a random search in order to conduct said search.
5. Security personnel are to cooperate fully with any Central Command Staff (such as Emergency Response Teams) in order to eliminate the threat to the station.
6. The Security SOP will detail armament, armory, and safety procedures.
## Secure Areas:
1. Secure areas require an access permit, unless required by a staff job.
2. Secure areas: Security department, EVA Storage, Tech Storage, Gravity Generator, all Engineering areas beyond the lobby, Vault, and areas requiring Command access.
3. There are no restrictions on bolting Secure Areas. Secure Areas may be left bolted or unbolted at the discretion of Command personnel.
4. Secure areas are not to be entered by non-command, unless required by their job.
## Medical:
It is recommended that medical entrances be set to emergency access to allow crew members to heal themselves in emergencies.
## General Crew:
1. Personnel are to follow the instructions of Security staff, so long as they are within the bounds of Corporate Law and are not acting against the general well-being of the station and its crew.
2. Personnel are advised to shelter in place and comply with Security's orders.
3. In special situations and repeated non-compliance, failure to comply with Security personnel may result in lethal force, at the discretion of the captain or Head of Security.
